secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co). Optional — app falls back to bundled JSON content without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (sb_secret_...). Optional — needed for commerce/admin/AI features.

secrets.name: RECOVERY_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: 64-hex-char AES-256 key for payment recovery codes. Optional — needed for checkout/restore.

secrets.name: SEPAY_WEBHOOK_API_KEY
secrets.description: SePay webhook API key. Optional — needed for payment webhooks.

secrets.name: SEPAY_BANK_NAME
secrets.description: Bank gateway name in SePay (e.g. MBBank). Optional.

secrets.name: SEPAY_ACCOUNT_NAME
secrets.description: SePay bank account holder name. Optional.

secrets.name: SEPAY_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: SePay legacy v1 User API token. Optional — needed for reconciliation.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: Random secret protecting the reconciliation endpoint. Optional.

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Vercel AI Gateway API key for AI pack generation. Optional — needed for AI features.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Server-only admin login password (min 16 chars). Optional — needed for /admin panel.
